hotel.name: JW Marriott Khao Lak Resort & Spa

verified_facts.text: The resort is on Khuk Khak Beach in Phang Nga, overlooking the Andaman Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax with your loved ones and reconnect with the world on the golden shores of Khuk Khak Beach, overlooking the Andaman Sea.

verified_facts.text: The resort's setting combines sea, sand, tropical greenery, granite mountains and nearby waterfalls.
verified_facts.excerpt: a sense of presence unfolds amidst sun, sea, sand, tropical greenery, granite mountains and nearby waterfalls

verified_facts.text: Signature pool access rooms let guests slip into what the resort calls Southeast Asia's longest lagoon pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our signature pool access rooms let couples and families alike to slip effortlessly into almost 2.5 kilometers of Southeast Asia's longest lagoon pool.

verified_facts.text: Signature Pool Access rooms have a terrace with direct access to the lagoon pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each Pool Access room features a terrace with direct access to the spectacular pool that meanders lazily through the entire resort

verified_facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and contemporary Thai-style furnishings with authentic local fabrics.
verified_facts.excerpt: With floor-to-ceiling windows, the Khao Lak hotel rooms...See More are bathed in an abundance of natural light that brings to life the stunning décor and interior design with contemporary Thai-style furnishings and authentic local fabrics.

verified_facts.text: The beachfront villas have private pools, ocean views and separate living, sleeping and dining quarters.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each villa enjoys stunning ocean views, private pools and separate living, sleeping and dining quarters.

verified_facts.text: Villa guests have a personal villa butler on hand around the clock.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your personal villa butler is on hand around the clock to elevate your stay

verified_facts.text: A Coconut Boat cruises the lagoon pool each day, serving fresh coconuts to guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: A truly unique experience within our lagoon pool is the Coconut Boat, which cruises gently each day past pool access rooms and public areas, serving fresh coconuts for guests to enjoy.

verified_facts.text: The resort has a 27-acre JW Garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: the resort features a 27-acre JW Garden

verified_facts.text: The JW Garden is a working farm that grows over 200 varieties of plants, fruits, vegetables, leaves and herbs for the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Supplying the resort with fresh organic produce, our working farm invites all guests to discover the wonders of horticulture and learn how we cultivate over 200 varieties of plants, fruits, vegetables, leaves and herbs.

verified_facts.text: The farm is home to two water buffalo, a herd of goats, and chickens and ducks.
verified_facts.excerpt: including our two water buffalo, a herd of goats, and a flock of chickens and ducks supplying a hotel with free-range eggs

verified_facts.text: Guests can join the Bamboo Shark Nursery & Conservation Center to help breed and nurture bamboo sharks before they are released into the wild.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join the Bamboo Shark Nursery & Conservation Center to help breed and nurture bamboo sharks before releasing them back into the wild to restore the balance of the marine ecosystem.

verified_facts.text: Guests can release baby bamboo sharks back into the wild.
verified_facts.excerpt: Release baby bamboo sharks back into the wild

verified_facts.text: Quan Spa offers signature massages and an Andaman rejuvenation body wrap.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy our signature massages or book an Andaman rejuvenation body wrap at our Khao Lak spa.

verified_facts.text: Quan Spa hosts a coconut oil workshop where guests learn to extract oil from coconuts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Learn more about the magic of Thailand's wonder fruit with our exclusive organic coconut oil workshop at QuanSpa.

verified_facts.text: The Aqua Play Zone has water slides, a wave pool, a fountain trampoline and a children's playground.
verified_facts.excerpt: experiencing our exciting Aqua Play Zone, complete with water slides, a wave pool, a fountain trampoline, a dedicated children’s playground

verified_facts.text: The Family by JW Club offers gardening and cooking workshops connected to the JW Garden, jungle-themed play zones and craft studios.
verified_facts.excerpt: From gardening and cooking workshops connected to our JW Garden, to jungle themed play zones, craft studios and gentle coastal storytelling

verified_facts.text: The Family by JW Club is open every day and offers many activities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Family by JW Club is open every day, has plenty of space, and offers many activities.

verified_facts.text: Olive serves authentic Italian classics with a curated selection of mono-cultivar olive oils.
verified_facts.excerpt: Olive presents authentic Italian classics, elevated through a curated selection of mono-cultivar olive oils and a refined wine collection.

verified_facts.text: Ta-Krai serves authentic Thai flavors with beach sunset views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor authentic Thai flavors at Ta-Krai restaurant, with stunning beach sunset views.

verified_facts.text: Stand-up paddle boards, sea kayaks and boogie boards are available from the Watersports Hut on Khuk Khak Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spend hours of fun with our stand-up paddle boards, sea kayaks, or boogie boards available from the Watersports Hut on the golden sands of Khuk Khak Beach.

verified_facts.text: The resort's location offers diving and snorkeling at the Similan and Surin Islands.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our location offers world-class diving and snorkeling at the Similan and Surin Islands

verified_facts.text: A Phang Nga cacao pod-to-bar experience at the resort's Chocolate Atelier was created with Duc de Praslin.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the journey of locally grown Phang Nga cacao through an immersive experience at JW Marriott Khao Lak, created in collaboration with Duc de Praslin.

verified_facts.text: Phuket International Airport is about 83 km from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: HKT is located approximately 83.0 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at JW Marriott Khao Lak Resort & Spa.

verified_facts.text: Modern architecture is blended with Thai touches such as curved multitiered roofs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Modern architecture blends aesthetically with Thai touches like the curved multitiered roofs

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms have deep terrazzo bathtubs and generous balconies or terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guest rooms, while not the resort’s design pinnacle, are outfitted with deep terrazzo bathtubs and generous-sized balconies or terraces
